== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Laceration]].
* Renew the spirit when foes are under 90% health in order to get both the bleeding condition and the health degeneration.
**Alternatively, destroy the spirit before renewing it with skills such as [[Spirit to Flesh]] or [[Feast of Souls]] to ensure your allies won't be affected.
**Using this you can maintain both effects on a large number of foes at 10 beast mastery
